title: Pro expiry · unfinished batch paused
expect: Production Pro supporting views use the existing premium duck and synthetic price, date and eligibility facts.
Purchase, restoration, management and legal actions are explicitly simulated; no StoreKit, real library or account is accessed.
The monthly and annual offers have no Apple introductory trial. Welcome is a separate synthetic state.
Welcome expiry pauses the 500 unfinished items in a synthetic 1,000-item batch; completed results and task progress remain.
Subscribe is the route to resuming existing work. Submitting the batch during welcome does not grant continuation beyond expiry.
This access-required state is not the user queue-pause preference and does not switch Auto Backup off; production enforcement is not connected.
